```yaml
name: Pro Integration Tests

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'pro'
      - 'tests/pro/**'
      - 'bin/utils/pro-detector.js'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'pro'
      - 'tests/pro/**'
      - 'bin/utils/pro-detector.js'
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 6 * * 1'  # Monday at 6 AM UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    concurrency: pro-integration-tests

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '14'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Check for GitHub PAT
      id: check-pat
      run: echo "::set-output name=has_pat::$(if [ -n "${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" ]; then echo "true"; else echo "false"; fi)"

    - name: Skip if no PAT
      if: ${{ steps.check-pat.outputs.has_pat == 'false' }}
      run: exit 0

    - name: Run integration tests
      run: npm test -- --integration

    - name: Upload test results
      uses: mikepenz/action-junit-report@v4
      with:
        github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        report_paths: '**/results/*.xml'
        test_files_prefix: 'tests/pro/'
```
